Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Chesteen
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 01/18/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 81 as introduced would allow members of the Alabama Trust Fund (ATF) Board, or any committee established by the ATF Board, to attend meetings virtually which could reduce reimbursement expenses, per diem and travel, of the board by an estimated $159 per member for each board meeting attended virtually.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs

Date: 03/28/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 81 as passed the Senate would allow members of the Alabama Trust Fund (ATF) Board, or any committee established by the ATF Board, to attend meetings virtually which could reduce reimbursement expenses, per diem and travel, of the board by an estimated $159 per member for each board meeting attended virtually.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
